treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Hungary and the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2014), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: Hatályba lép: 2015. VI. 19-én a 21/2015. (VI. 15.) KKM közlemény alapján. [jogtar note to § 4(2): §§ 2-3 (the Convention text) enter into force on the date set in Article 28(2) of the Convention]
source_title: 2014. évi XLIX. törvény (HU-BH DTC, Hungarian and English text), Nemzeti Jogszabálytár / net.jogtar.hu

rates.quote: (a) zero per cent (0%) of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership that is not liable to tax); and
(b) five per cent (5%) of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Income from debt-claims arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: MLI art. 7(1) (replacing treaty Art. 27 main-purpose rule, notified by Hungary under Art. 7(17)(a))
ppt.quote: Pursuant to Article 7(17)(a) of the Convention, Hungary considers that the following agreements ... contain a provision described in Article 7(2) ... Bahrain ... Article 27. [Treaty Art. 27: 'a resident of a Contracting State shall not receive the benefit of any reduction in or exemption from tax provided for in this Convention by the other Contracting State if the competent authority of the other State determines that the main purpose or one of the main purposes of such resident or a person connected with such resident was to obtain the benefits of this Convention.']

notes: Art. 28(2)(a): taxes withheld at source apply to income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF -> 2016-01-01 (NAV list: applicable from 2016-01-01). Dividend tier (a) 0% applies to any company beneficial owner (other than a non-taxable partnership) with no minimum holding; ownership_threshold set to '0' to mark it as a company-only tier, (b) 5% general. The treaty already contained a discretionary main-purpose rule (Art. 27) from 2016; MLI PPT effective for WHT from 2023-01-01 per treaty map. Hungary reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely (no 365-day holding period).
unverified: Bahrain's MLI notification under Art. 7(17)(a) for this treaty not checked; MLI WHT effective date 2023-01-01 taken from treaty map.
